classifier.method: zero-shot, prompt ensemble (mean of normalised text embeddings per option), softmax over options at temperature 0.01 on cosine similarity; propulsion = P(manual)*P(self/attendant/empty | manual) + (1-P(manual)) -> not_applicable

attendant: a person pushing someone else in a wheelchair from behind
a helper standing behind a wheelchair holding the handles
not_applicable: an empty wheelchair with nobody in it
self: a person pushing the wheels of their own wheelchair
a person wheeling themselves in a manual wheelchair

lookalike: a baggage cart at an airport
manual: a manual wheelchair with large rear wheels and push rims
a person sitting in a manual wheelchair
a lightweight sports wheelchair pushed by hand
a hospital-style manual wheelchair with push handles
other_aid: a person riding a mobility scooter
a rollator walker with wheels and a seat
powered: an electric powered wheelchair with a joystick control
a person in a power wheelchair
a motorized wheelchair with a battery box and small wheels

daylight: a photo taken outdoors in bright sunlight
indoor: a photo taken indoors under artificial light
low_light: a dark photo taken at night
a dimly lit scene in low light
shade: an outdoor photo in the shade

heavy: a wheelchair mostly hidden, only a small part visible
a heavily occluded wheelchair in a crowd
none: a fully visible wheelchair, nothing blocking the view
the whole mobility device is clearly visible
partial: a wheelchair partly hidden behind other objects or people
a wheelchair cut off by the edge of the photo

no: an empty wheelchair with nobody in it
an empty mobility device with no one sitting on it
yes: a person sitting in a wheelchair
a person seated on a mobility device

curb: a wheelchair at a street curb
a curb ramp at a crosswalk
the edge of a sidewalk by the road
other: on a stage or at an event
sidewalk: a pavement or footpath in a city street
vehicle: a wheelchair getting into a van or car
a wheelchair ramp on a bus
a wheelchair lift on a vehicle

front: a wheelchair seen from the front
a front view of a person in a wheelchair facing the camera
rear: a rear view of a wheelchair, back of the seat facing the camera
side: a side view of a wheelchair in profile
a wheelchair seen from the side
three-quarter: a three-quarter view of a wheelchair, seen diagonally from the front corner
a wheelchair photographed at an angle

runs_locally: images are processed on the lab machine; nothing is uploaded
screening_policy: flags are suggestions for the human reviewer; the model never excludes an image

clinical_setting: a nurse in a medical setting
not_a_photo: a photo taken with a camera
a snapshot of a real scene
visible_face: a photo where a person's face is clearly visible
a close-up portrait of a person's face
a person looking at the camera
an object with no face visible
a person far away, face too small to see
